title: RemoteDeviceEnrolledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'remote.device.enrolled'. STATE.md "Loombre Remote — embedded WireGuard + three-path wizard + reachability proof + posture card" (R2/R9): emitted by POST /admin/remote/wireguard/devices on successful enrollment. R9's no-secrets rule: never carries the peer private key, the generated wg-quick config text, or the tunnel IP — those live only in the one-time RemoteWireguardEnrollment API response, never persisted or re-emitted anywhere, including here. `userId` is the device owner (not necessarily the acting admin — envelope.actorUserId already carries the admin who performed the enrollment). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same posture as user.invited.

deviceId.description: The devices.id row created for this enrollment (kind='remote').

name.description: The device label supplied at enrollment.
